info.name: QuickCart
info.description:
Postman collection for the QuickCart demo API (QA course project).

Design notes:
- base_url comes from the environment; no hardcoded localhost.
- Every folder starts by logging in user A, so requests run independently of earlier folders.
- Session cookies handle login automatically (Postman/Newman cookie jar, no tokens).
- A logged-out state is produced with POST /api/logout (server-side session clear), not by touching the cookie jar.
- Users are registered with random emails (pre-request scripts); cart/coupon/checkout tests use OWN test products created in Setup, so seeded data and seed stock are never depleted.
- Created ids are saved into collection variables (email_a, product_a..product_zero, product_e, order_id, stock_a0) from response bodies.
- {{no_such_id}} = 999999 is a sentinel id that must never exist in this database (verified in Setup).
- The collection is RE-RUNNABLE on a dirty database: run it twice in a row without resetting the DB.
